{
  "name": "waitron-cloud",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@9.15.0",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=26"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "typecheck": "tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir apps/portal typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/ui-smoke typecheck",
    "test": "node scripts/test-postgres.mjs",
    "test:registration": "pnpm --filter @waitron-cloud/registration test",
    "test:abuse": "node scripts/test-postgres.mjs exec pnpm --dir packages/account-http exec node --test --test-timeout=120000 test/abuse-receipt.test.ts test/abuse-boundaries.test.ts",
    "test:worker-scheduling": "node --test packages/registration/test/worker-loop.test.ts scripts/verify-worker-scheduling-receipt.test.mjs",
    "test:managed-keys": "node scripts/test-postgres.mjs exec pnpm --dir packages/backups exec node --test --test-timeout=30000 test/key-operations.test.ts",
    "test:backup-transfers": "node scripts/test-postgres.mjs exec node scripts/backup-transfer-receipt.mjs",
    "test:control-plane-outages": "node scripts/test-postgres.mjs exec node scripts/control-plane-outage-receipt.mjs /tmp/cloud-control-plane-outage-receipt.json && node scripts/verify-control-plane-outage-receipt.mjs /tmp/cloud-control-plane-outage-receipt.json",
    "test:cell-movement-receipt": "node --test scripts/verify-cell-movement-receipt.test.mjs",
    "verify:cell-movement": "node scripts/verify-cell-movement-receipt.mjs",
    "proof:remote-reconciler": "node scripts/test-postgres.mjs exec node scripts/remote-reconciler-receipt.mjs /tmp/cloud-remote-reconciler-receipt.json && node scripts/verify-remote-reconciler-receipt.mjs /tmp/cloud-remote-reconciler-receipt.json",
    "proof:two-venue-milestone": "node scripts/test-postgres.mjs exec node scripts/cloud-two-venue-milestone-receipt.mjs",
    "proof:local-stack": "node scripts/local-stack-proof.mjs",
    "verify:local-stack": "node scripts/verify-local-stack-receipt.mjs",
    "test:local-stack": "node --test deploy/local-stack/*.test.mjs scripts/local-stack-compose.test.mjs scripts/local-stack-lifecycle.test.mjs scripts/verify-local-stack-receipt.test.mjs scripts/scheduled-usage-proof.test.mjs scripts/verify-schema-upgrade-receipt.test.mjs scripts/schema-upgrade-fixture.test.mjs",
    "proof:database-recovery": "node scripts/database-recovery-receipt.mjs",
    "verify:database-recovery": "node scripts/verify-database-recovery-receipt.mjs",
    "test:database-recovery-receipt": "node --check scripts/database-recovery-fixture.mjs && node --check scripts/database-recovery-receipt.mjs && node --test scripts/verify-database-recovery-receipt.test.mjs scripts/database-recovery-migrations.test.mjs",
    "test:two-venue-milestone-receipt": "node --test scripts/milestone-proof-helpers.test.mjs scripts/verify-managed-recovery-receipt.test.mjs scripts/verify-two-venue-milestone-receipt.test.mjs",
    "verify:two-venue-milestone": "node scripts/verify-two-venue-milestone-receipt.mjs",
    "test:remote-reconciler-receipt": "node --test scripts/verify-remote-reconciler-receipt.test.mjs",
    "verify:remote-reconciler": "node scripts/verify-remote-reconciler-receipt.mjs",
    "measure:worker-scheduling-baseline": "node scripts/test-postgres.mjs exec node scripts/worker-scheduling-receipt.mjs --baseline /tmp/cloud-worker-scheduling-baseline.json",
    "db:migrate": "pnpm --filter @waitron-cloud/registration db:migrate",
    "history:cleanup": "pnpm --dir packages/registration history:cleanup",
    "usage:reconcile": "pnpm --dir packages/registration usage:reconcile",
    "relay:control": "pnpm --silent --dir packages/registration relay:control",
    "operations:status": "node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/operations/src/cli.ts",
    "local-stack:up": "node scripts/local-stack-lifecycle.mjs up",
    "local-stack:upgrade": "node scripts/local-stack-lifecycle.mjs upgrade",
    "local-stack:status": "docker compose --env-file deploy/local-stack/local.env ps -a",
    "local-stack:down": "docker compose --env-file deploy/local-stack/local.env down --remove-orphans",
    "local-stack:reset": "docker compose --env-file deploy/local-stack/local.env down --volumes --remove-orphans",
    "test:packages": "pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 test",
    "mail:up": "docker compose up -d --wait mailpit",
    "mail:down": "docker compose rm -s -f mailpit",
    "mail:demo": "node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/registration/src/mail-demo.ts",
    "mail:worker": "node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/registration/src/email-worker-cli.ts",
    "mail:status": "node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/registration/src/email-worker-cli.ts --status",
    "account:serve": "node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/account-http/src/server-cli.ts",
    "test:ui": "pnpm --filter @waitron-cloud/ui-smoke test",
    "portal:build": "pnpm --filter @waitron-cloud/portal build",
    "backup:worker": "node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/backups/src/worker-cli.ts",
    "backup:status": "node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/backups/src/worker-cli.ts --status",
    "keys:check": "node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/backups/src/key-operations-cli.ts",
    "monitor:worker": "node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/registration/src/monitor-cli.ts",
    "monitor:status": "node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/registration/src/monitor-cli.ts --status",
    "remote:probe": "node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/remote-access/src/probe-cli.ts",
    "remote:reconcile": "node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/remote-access/src/reconciler-cli.ts",
    "proof:scheduled-usage": "node scripts/scheduled-usage-proof.mjs",
    "proof:schema-upgrade": "node scripts/schema-upgrade-receipt.mjs",
    "verify:schema-upgrade": "node scripts/verify-schema-upgrade-receipt.mjs",
    "test:public-gateway-limits": "node --test --test-timeout=30000 scripts/public-gateway-limits.test.mjs scripts/verify-public-gateway-limits-receipt.test.mjs",
    "verify:public-gateway-limits": "node scripts/verify-public-gateway-limits-receipt.mjs",
    "proof:operations-collection": "node scripts/operations-collection-proof.mjs",
    "test:backup-capacity": "node --test scripts/backup-capacity-fixture.test.mjs scripts/verify-backup-transfer-receipt.test.mjs scripts/verify-backup-capacity-receipt.test.mjs",
    "proof:backup-capacity": "node scripts/backup-capacity-receipt.mjs"

  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^24.0.0",
